goal: Test whether KINETIC understood Wanaka Studio's layout grammar, typography roles, responsive composition, scroll pacing and interaction model without reusing protected content.
core_concept: An annotated studio folio where mixed typography becomes the spatial system and offset project media interrupts a restrained paper field.

composition_plan.spatial_system: A wide editorial grid alternates oversized text fields with offset media blocks; mobile deliberately re-composes those layers into one column.
composition_plan.visual_hierarchy: The manifesto leads, serif editorial statements establish chapter rhythm, project imagery carries local emphasis, and compact labels/navigation remain subordinate.
composition_plan.pacing: Long paper-like pauses separate dense visual moments so each portfolio chapter arrives as a distinct scroll beat.
composition_plan.density: Sparse shell with isolated high-density project moments rather than uniform card packing.

typography_plan.display_role: A heavy system grotesk supplies emphatic fragments, labels and navigation without using Wanaka fonts.
typography_plan.body_role: A system serif supplies editorial statements and reflective pacing without using Wanaka fonts.
typography_plan.scale_strategy: Fluid clamp-based display sizes create deliberate line breaks at desktop and mobile rather than proportionally shrinking one composition.
typography_plan.contrast_strategy: Weight, family and scale contrast replace decorative color as the primary hierarchy device.
typography_plan.rhythm: Tight grotesk lines alternate with open serif lines and generous section whitespace.
typography_plan.responsive_behavior: Mobile stacks and overlaps selected hero layers while preserving the type-role contrast and priority order.

art_direction.imagery_strategy: Use only KINETIC-authored CSS geometry and abstract generated placeholders that preserve media role, crop and visual weight without depicting Wanaka work.
art_direction.asset_strategy: No external assets, logos, source imagery, copied illustrations, source fonts or source copy; all visual material is CSS/HTML authored inside V0.
art_direction.texture: Mostly clean paper and ink with restrained halftone/noise accents authored in CSS.
art_direction.material: Paper editorial field contrasted with a pale embossed geometric object and flat saturated accent discs.
art_direction.depth: Depth comes from controlled overlap, clipping and shadows on substitute forms rather than WebGL or proprietary media.
art_direction.layering: Text, geometric object, circular affordance and lower hero collage overlap at intentional z-levels; project sections return to a flatter editorial plane.
art_direction.color_logic: Warm white and near-black form the shell; one electric-violet accent marks interactive or spatial emphasis.

signature_move.name: folio orbit affordance
signature_move.central_idea: A circular action marker follows focus within a project media plane and makes the portfolio interaction visibly legible.
signature_move.trigger: pointer hover or keyboard focus on a project link
signature_move.visual_transformation: The action circle expands from the media crop while the image shifts slightly within its frame.
signature_move.purpose: Connect the user's action to the selected work without adding decorative motion elsewhere.
signature_move.content_relationship: The affordance is anchored to the active project media and disappears when no project is active.
signature_move.reduced_motion_alternative: Show a static outlined action circle on focus/hover with no translation or scaling.
signature_move.capture_checkpoint: desktop project-hover after the circular marker is fully visible

scroll_storyboard: Manifesto hero enters as a composed still with only restrained layer settling.
Capability copy yields to a large editorial portfolio statement after a long whitespace beat.
Project media and description alternate across the grid as the document scrolls.
Recent-work index compresses the rhythm before the final conversation close.
transitions: opacity and translate transitions use canonical KINETIC motion tokens
project hover uses canonical fast/standard tokens
no autonomous carousel, video or looping animation
motion_plan.reduced_motion_behavior: Disable scroll-linked transforms and continuous interpolation; preserve hierarchy, final positions and visible focus/hover affordances.

retained_principles: offset media rhythm rather than a uniform card grid
responsive re-composition rather than simple shrinking
visible interaction affordance at the media surface
deliberately_rejected_principles: exact section geometry and hidden implementation

design_reference_sources.retrieval_reason: Use an audited curated-design source only as abstract comparative context while the Wanaka DesignCase remains the primary reference.
knowledge_used: Curated website references are comparison evidence, not reusable source material.

motion_reference_sources.retrieval_reason: Use the audited motion-study category to require ordered observable states without copying implementation or media.
knowledge_used: Motion fidelity should be studied through explicit trigger and checkpoint states.

typography_sources.retrieval_reason: Use the audited typography-discovery category to reason about role pairing while choosing only system substitutes.
knowledge_used: Typeface roles and pairing can be evaluated independently of copying a proprietary font asset.

composition_differences: V0 is a declared internal fidelity study, not an original candidate; exact source geometry is prohibited.
typography_differences: Use system grotesk and serif substitutes only; no Wanaka font files or exact typesetting.
motion_differences: Implement only observable state relationships with KINETIC tokens; do not reconstruct hidden source choreography.
originality_plan.asset_non_reuse: All imagery is KINETIC-authored CSS geometry; no Wanaka asset, logo, copy, artwork, font, code or project identity is reused.
originality_plan.signature_move_hypothesis: The visible project-affordance relationship can be studied with an independently implemented focus/hover circle.

quality_hypothesis: If V0 preserves mixed-type hierarchy, whitespace pacing, offset media rhythm, responsive re-composition and visible project affordance using wholly substitute content, a human can determine whether KINETIC understood the reference grammar without mistaking the study for a clone.
